details.summary: Small daytime flyers with eight wing colours.

sections.title: Encounter
sections.text: Look for butterflies hovering above the forest floor during the day.

care.label: Lure
care.text: Vanilla flowers, Elanor, Niphredil, Mallorn Blossom or Nectar Bloom; follows upward and downward too.

care.label: Feeding
care.text: Flowers heal up to {{lothlorien:rule/food-health}} health points and prevent ordinary despawning.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: No

care.label: Lead
care.text: Yes

details.summary: Wary woodland herds, with antlered bucks and spotted fawns.

sections.title: Approach
sections.text: Deer are more common deeper inside the forest. Sneak to approach without alarming the herd. Negative Harmony and nearby danger can override a food lure.

care.label: Lure
care.text: Western Corn Grain while calm or friendly; seeds do not work.

care.label: Feeding
care.text: Grain breeds adults and speeds fawn growth; it does not heal. Feeding for breeding or growth makes deer familiar with players and prevents ordinary despawning. Alarms and negative Harmony still make them flee.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: Western Corn Grain; fawns mature in {{lothlorien:rule/deer-maturity|duration}}, faster with grain.

care.label: Lead
care.text: Yes

production: Antlers found on the ground are naturally generated decorations. Collect them from the forest floor.
dropNotes: Fawns drop nothing. Only adult bucks can drop an antler; adult does do not.

details.summary: Five professions bring the villages to life.

sections.title: Village life
sections.text: Gardeners, healers, woodwrights, lamplighters and the Loremaster inhabit newly generated villages. Visit their trees to find lessons, requests and shops.

sections.title: Trading & progression
sections.text: Gardeners, healers, woodwrights and lamplighters buy and sell supplies for emeralds. Guest and Friend stock expands at Welcome, Trusted and Elf-friend Renown; Friend Harmony improves prices. Uneasy standing limits stock to its starting level regardless of Renown, and Shunned or Hated players are refused. Final equipment needs both Elf-friend Renown and Friend Harmony.

sections.title: Lessons & requests
sections.text: Speak with the Loremaster for lessons and profession requests. Finish Chapters I and II to unlock requests. One task slot is shared by deed lessons and requests: accept first, then perform the deed and turn it in. Deliver requests to the matching profession; the Loremaster accepts them when none lives nearby.

sections.title: Approach
sections.text: Elves flee when hurt, and wardens defend them. Healers roam farther during the day and return towards home at dusk.

sections.title: Healing & friendship
sections.text: A healer can grant regeneration to nearby injured elves and wardens. Injured Friends of LothlÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³rien can also receive regeneration when close and in clear sight.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: No; residents are not replaced when they die.

care.label: Lead
care.text: Yes. Release the lead to set a new home; shears cut the lead.

details.summary: Bow-carrying defenders of the forest and its villages.

sections.title: Role
sections.text: Wardens guard village trees and also appear naturally in LothlÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³rien. They fight monsters, including creepers and daylight spiders.

sections.title: Approach
sections.text: Attacking an elf or warden can turn the guards against you. Wardens also attack Hated players on sight; check the Harmony guide before approaching with a damaged reputation.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: No

care.label: Lead
care.text: Yes. The first lead keeps a natural warden from despawning. Release it to set a new home; shears cut the lead.

details.summary: Tiny hovering insects that glow in the dark.

sections.title: Encounter
sections.text: Look for fireflies at night or in shade. Their glowing abdomen is visible with Vibrant Visuals; it does not light nearby blocks.

care.label: Lure
care.text: None

care.label: Feeding
care.text: None

care.label: Breeding
care.text: No

care.label: Lead
care.text: No; transport in a Bottle of Fireflies.

production: Use an empty glass bottle on a living firefly to obtain a Bottle of Fireflies. Use it against a block face with air beside it to release the firefly and recover the glass bottle. Its name and remaining health are preserved. Released fireflies do not ordinarily despawn.

details.summary: Blue, yellow and pink birds with woodland songs.

sections.title: Encounter
sections.text: Songbirds fly independently during the day and can land on the ground. They do not share the Harmony-based wariness of deer.

care.label: Lure
care.text: Wheat or Western Corn Grain, including upward and downward; seeds do not work.

care.label: Feeding
care.text: Grain heals up to {{lothlorien:rule/food-health}} health points and prevents ordinary despawning.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: No

care.label: Lead
care.text: Yes

details.summary: Small forest-floor residents drawn to Mallorn Acorns.

sections.title: Approach
sections.text: Negative Harmony and nearby alarms can make a squirrel flee even when you hold an acorn.

care.label: Lure
care.text: Mallorn Acorns while calm or friendly.

care.label: Feeding
care.text: Acorns heal up to {{lothlorien:rule/food-health}} health points. Feeding outside Lothlorien, or while leashed, prevents ordinary despawning. Inside the forest, an eligible Friend can start an errand instead; feeding there does not make it stay.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: No

care.label: Lead
care.text: Yes

production: Inside Lothlorien, a Friend can offer a Mallorn Acorn to an unalarmed, unleashed squirrel to start an errand. An injured squirrel eats to heal instead. It runs away, digs and returns with one of the gifts listed below. After a successful gift, that squirrel has a cooldown of {{lothlorien:rule/errand-cooldown|duration}}. Stay close when it returns. Leashing, damage, separation or losing Friend standing can end the errand; an errand that cannot finish ends after {{lothlorien:rule/errand-timeout|duration}}.

details.summary: White water birds with cygnets and naturally shed feathers.

sections.title: Encounter
sections.text: Look on Lothlorien waters and nearby rivers. Swans float at the surface and walk on land. Alarms and negative Harmony take precedence over a food lure.

care.label: Lure
care.text: Wheat or Western Corn Grain while calm or friendly.

care.label: Feeding
care.text: Grain breeds adults and speeds cygnet growth; it does not heal.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: Wheat or Western Corn Grain, including outside the forest. Cygnets mature in {{lothlorien:rule/swan-maturity|duration}}, faster with grain.

care.label: Lead
care.text: Yes

production: Adult swans shed {{lothlorien:rule/swan-shed-count}} feather every {{lothlorien:rule/swan-shed-min}}-{{lothlorien:rule/swan-shed-max}} seconds. Cygnets do not; this is separate from death drops.

sections.title: Approach
sections.text: Wild unicorns are wary of strangers. Give them space and avoid frightening nearby animals.

spoilers.title: Earning a bond
spoilers.text: Become a Friend of LothlÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³rien and hold Elanor to lure a unicorn. Offer {{lothlorien:rule/unicorn-offers}} Elanor flowers, leaving at least {{lothlorien:rule/unicorn-gap}} seconds between accepted offers. Trust remains between visits. Accepted offers restore up to {{lothlorien:rule/food-health}} health points. The bond belongs to the player who completes it.

spoilers.title: Caring for a bonded unicorn
spoilers.text: The bonded owner can offer Elanor to heal an injured unicorn. That interaction heals instead of mounting; at full health the owner mounts normally. Bonded unicorns can swim, and you receive a message if yours dies. They take ordinary fall damage and do not regain health passively: use Elanor to care for them.

care.label: Lure
care.text: Elanor held by a Friend of Lothlorien; an alarmed wild unicorn ignores offers.

care.label: Feeding
care.text: Accepted Elanor offers heal up to {{lothlorien:rule/food-health}} health points. Once bonded, only its owner can feed or name it.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: No

care.label: Lead
care.text: No

care.label: Riding
care.text: Only its bonded owner, without a saddle.

details.summary: A solitary white hart, always bearing antlers.

sections.title: Approach
sections.text: A white deer shares the ordinary deer's Harmony-based wariness. Approach gently and avoid alarming it.

care.label: Lure
care.text: Mallorn Acorns while calm or friendly.

care.label: Feeding
care.text: Acorns heal up to {{lothlorien:rule/food-health}} health points. Outside Lothlorien, feeding prevents ordinary despawning; an eligible Friend inside can start guidance instead.

care.label: Breeding
care.text: No; no fawn form.

care.label: Lead
care.text: Yes; a lead prevents or interrupts guidance.

production: Inside Lothlorien, a Friend can offer a Mallorn Acorn to an unleashed, unalarmed White Deer to begin guidance. An injured deer eats to heal instead. Follow it towards a place deeper in the forest, where it gives a Great Mallorn Nut once in its lifetime. Attaching a lead interrupts the walk. If its destination becomes blocked or flooded, offer another acorn to start a new search. Outside feeding does not spend the gift.

details.introduction: Grants a short regeneration effect and removes poison when consumed.
Made from Western Corn grain and sugar. Cook the dough into Lembas Cake, then wrap it for travel.
A placeable layer of fallen Mallorn petals. Under Mallorn leaves, dewy patches offer another place to gather morning dew with a glass bottle.
A crop ingredient for Lembas, and food or lure for several woodland animals.
Plant these to grow Western Corn. Its grain supplies Lembas recipes and food or lures for woodland animals.
Held offhand. Grants Regeneration level {{lothlorien:rule/belt-level}} while your health is strictly below half your maximum.

equipment.summary: Hold the belt in your offhand to recover health when badly injured.

stats.label: Activation
stats.value: Health below {{lothlorien:rule/belt-health-fraction}} of your maximum; exactly that threshold does not trigger it.

notes: Healing can continue briefly after you reach half health or put the belt away.
The belt and the Phial of Galadriel share the offhand slot, so you must choose which to hold.

details.introduction: A one-time gift from a White Deer to a Friend of Lothlorien. Plant it to grow a giant Mallorn; leave room for its crown and roots.
A journey food that restores {{lothlorien:rule/lembas-food}} food points and removes the Hunger effect when eaten.
Plants an ordinary Mallorn sapling. Also used when interacting with white deer and squirrels.
Worn in the chest slot. Sneaking without moving for {{lothlorien:rule/cloak-still-seconds|duration}} grants invisibility; movement stops its renewal.

equipment.summary: Sneak and stand still to become invisible.

stats.label: Effect
stats.value: Invisibility while you remain still and sneaking.

notes: Moving, standing up or removing the cloak ends its invisibility shortly afterward.
It accepts chest-armour enchantments, but cannot be dyed or given an armour trim. It does not protect you from freezing.

details.introduction: Held offhand. Creates nearby light in available air and repels spiders. It does not replace plants, solid blocks or fluids.

equipment.summary: Hold the phial in your offhand to light your surroundings and repel spiders.

stats.label: Repels
stats.value: Spiders and cave spiders within {{lothlorien:rule/phial-radius}} blocks

notes: Walls and terrain can block the light or keep spiders from being pushed away.
The phial and the Silver Belt share the offhand slot, so you must choose which to hold.

details.introduction: A {{lothlorien:rule/miruvor-sips}}-sip skin with a {{lothlorien:rule/miruvor-cooldown}}-second cooldown after each completed sip. Grants healing, regeneration and speed, and removes poison.
A partly filled collection bottle. Gather dew from damp Mallorn leaf litter or blossoms until it becomes Morning Dew.
Custom ammunition for the Bow of the Galadhrim.

equipment.summary: Recoverable ammunition for the Bow of the Galadhrim.

stats.label: Damage
stats.value: Same damage as an ordinary arrow

warnings: A normal bow cannot use Galadhrim arrows in Survival.

details.introduction: Refills through {{lothlorien:rule/nectar-stage}} stages when Mallorn leaves hang directly above it.
The Bow of the Galadhrim has a {{lothlorien:rule/bow-draw}}-second full draw and {{lothlorien:rule/bow-durability}} durability.

equipment.summary: A faster-drawing bow with the same damage as a normal bow. Use Galadhrim arrows to recover ammunition after hits.

stats.label: Damage
stats.value: Same damage as a normal bow

stats.label: Zoom
stats.value: Your view zooms in while drawing.

notes: Draw fully for the strongest shot.
Galadhrim arrows drop where they hit a creature, ready to collect. Ordinary arrows do not gain this recovery effect.
It cannot replace a normal bow in a dispenser crafting recipe.
